notes.subject: כיקר כרים
notes.rationale: 'the preciousness/choice fat of rams' — KJV 'fat of lambs' vs YLT 'preciousness of lambs' vs BSB 'glory of the fields'; Bambara keeps the fat/choice image with ɲɛgɛn of sagaw

notes.subject: כלו … כלו
notes.rationale: Verb repeated at verse end for finality — 'they vanish … they vanish'; Bambara repeats 'u bana' to keep it

notes.subject: bɔn
notes.rationale: אבד 'wander away, perish' rendered with 'be lost/finish' — the wandering image is dimmed

translation: Sabu mɔgɔkɛntɔnw bɛna bɔn, ani Yawe ka tɔkɔntɔnw bɛna yɛlɛma i n'a fɔ sagaw ka ɲɛgɛn — u bana, ni ɛnɛsogo ye u bana.
